$comment: WorkBuddy 开放平台发布元数据。由 scripts/package-workbuddy-skill.mjs 读取并注入发布副本的 SKILL.md frontmatter。name 必须与源 Skill 标识和安装目录 flow-diagram 一致；version 取 --version 或根 package.json，配置不能覆盖；description 默认继承源文件的 Agent 触发条件，可在此覆盖。description_zh/description_en 用于中英文市场详情介绍；examples_zh/examples_en 是可独立发起的案例。发布前逐项确认，尤其确认 author 为预期发布主体。字段定义见 docs/releasing.md §5.1 与 https://open.workbuddy.cn/docs/skill。
description_zh: 创建流程图、架构图、时序图和流程动画演示；验证、诊断已有图解，导出 JSON、离线 HTML、SVG、PNG 或 GIF，并管理项目图解偏好。需要 Node.js 20+ 和 npm；首次准备运行时需联网下载依赖，PNG/GIF 导出还需 Chrome/Chromium。
description_en: Create flowcharts, architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams and animated process explanations; validate or diagnose diagrams; export JSON, offline HTML, SVG, PNG or GIF; and manage project diagram preferences. Requires Node.js 20+ and npm, network access for initial runtime setup, and Chrome/Chromium for PNG/GIF export.
author: zac_ma
examples_zh: 画一个电商订单从提交到履约的流程图，用动画演示订单流转过程
画一个电商系统的分层架构图，标出接入层、服务层和数据层的职责与依赖方向
画一个电商订单从提交到履约的流程图，并导出为 GIF 动图
画一个带异常分支的电商退款流程图，画完后验证草稿，报告发现的问题
examples_en: Draw an animated flowchart of an e-commerce order from submission to fulfillment
Draw a layered architecture diagram of an e-commerce system, showing the responsibilities and dependency direction of its presentation, service, and data layers
Draw a flowchart of an e-commerce order from submission to fulfillment and export it as an animated GIF
Draw an e-commerce refund flowchart with exception branches, then validate the draft and report the findings
